 For the informant : Mr. Amit Kumar Anand, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order
3 09-05-2025 Heard the learned Senior counsel for the petitioner, Mr. N.K. Agrawal, learned APP for the State and the learned counsel for the informant, Sri Amit Kumar Anand.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Dagarua P.S. Case No. 178 of 2024 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 307, 376, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is said to have committed rape with the victim.
From the FIR, it appears that it is a case of failed promise of marriage and when the petitioner got married to some other girl, this case has been lodged.
It appears to be a case of consensual sex.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13863 of 2025(3) dt.09-05-2025 4.
Learned Senior counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.
5. Learned A.P.P. appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
